```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet")$schema
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  dplyr::slice_sample(n = 10)
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  dplyr::filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  dplyr::group_by(coin_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  dplyr::collect()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- arrow::read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- arrow::read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- arrow::read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  dplyr::mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_raw)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::rename(categories, category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  )
```

```{r}
metadata <- metadata |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    launch_date_parsed = dplyr::coalesce(
      lubridate::ymd(launch_date, quiet = TRUE),
      lubridate::mdy(launch_date, quiet = TRUE)
    )
  )

metadata |>
  dplyr::arrange(launch_date_parsed) |>
  dplyr::select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
prices |>
  dplyr::filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  dplyr::mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_raw)) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line()
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  dplyr::mutate(category_name = tidyr::replace_na(category_name, "Unknown")) |>
  dplyr::group_by(date, category_name) |>
  dplyr::summarise(market_cap_usd = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::group_by(date) |>
  dplyr::mutate(share = market_cap_usd / sum(market_cap_usd)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    category_name = forcats::fct_reorder(category_name, share, .fun = mean, .desc = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = date, y = share, fill = category_name)) +
  ggplot2::geom_area() +
  ggplot2::geom_rect(
    data = tibble::tibble(
      start = lubridate::ymd(c("2022-05-07", "2022-11-08")),
      end = lubridate::ymd(c("2022-05-12", "2022-11-11"))
    ),
    ggplot2::aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.numeric(lubridate::ymd(c("2022-05-07", "2022-05-12", "2022-11-08", "2022-11-11"))),
    color = "grey20",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "label",
    x = lubridate::ymd(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-09")),
    y = c(0.94, 0.8),
    label = c("Luna/UST crash\nMay 7-12, 2022", "FTX collapse\nNov 8-11, 2022"),
    size = 3,
    label.size = 0,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "C") +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Crypto market-cap share by category",
    subtitle = stringr::str_wrap(
      "Each band's share of total market cap across tracked coins; daily shares sum to 100%.",
      width = 75
    ),
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of total market cap",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: daily_prices.parquet, coin_metadata.parquet, and categories.parquet."
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
